provenance.evidence: Official park guide confirms two ponds, the wooded/natural Sanpoji setting and its floating-island marsh, and a more open Shakujii setting. Two separate original pond contours, one with denser generic tree masses and a small island, express this contrast. No source map or species geometry is copied and no connecting water channel is claimed.
